cb03a8ce4660cb8957ed.title: Senior Logistics Specialist Operations, Inbound Logistics
cb03a8ce4660cb8957ed.description:
At Five Below our growth is a result of the people who embrace our purpose: We know life is way better when you are free to Let Go & Have Fun in an amazing experience, filled with unlimited possibilities, priced so low, you can always say yes to the newest, coolest stuff! Just ask any of our over 35,000 crew members who work at Five Below and they’ll tell you there’s no other place like it. It all starts with our purpose and then, The Five Below Way, which is our values and behaviors that each and every crew member believes in.

It’s all about culture at Five Below, making this a place that can inspire you as much as you inspire us with big ideas, super energy, passion, and the ability to make the workplace a WOWplace!

**Location:** Ship Center New Jersey, Hybrid

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the Manager Inbound Logistics, this position is responsible for managing and optimizing end‑to‑end domestic transportation activities across multiple modes (truckload, LTL, intermodal, parcel, and dedicated fleets). This role serves as a senior subject‑matter expert, ensuring freight moves efficiently, cost‑effectively, and in compliance with service, safety, and regulatory requirements. The position works cross‑functionally with operations, procurement, customer service, and carriers to drive performance, resolve complex issues, and support continuous improvement initiatives

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Transportation, Business, (or equivalent experience)
* 5–8+ years of experience in domestic transportation or logistics operations
* Strong knowledge of U.S. domestic freight modes and carrier operations
* Hands‑on experience with Transportation Management Systems (TMS)
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret freight data and KPIs
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment
* Excellent communication, problem‑solving, and stakeholder management skills
* Proficient in using transportation management systems (Manhattan TMS preferred) and related software.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Problem-solving skills to address issues related to shipments and transportation.
* Negotiation skills for contract management with carriers and service providers.
* Microsoft Office products (i.e. Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access, etc.)

**Job Responsibilities:**

**Inbound Transportation Management**

* Coordinate and manage domestic inbound freight movements from suppliers, vendors, and transload facilities to distribution centers.
* Plan and optimize transportation capacity across truckload (TL), less-than-truckload (LTL), intermodal, and rail networks.
* Monitor shipment status and proactively address transit delays, service disruptions, and exceptions.
* Ensure timely delivery of inventory to support distribution center and store replenishment requirements.

**Carrier Management**

* Build and maintain relationships with transportation providers and third-party logistics (3PL) partners.
* Monitor carrier performance through KPIs including on-time pickup, on-time delivery, tender acceptance, and claims ratios.
* Participate in carrier sourcing events, RFPs, and rate negotiations.
* Support carrier compliance with routing guides, service requirements, and operational expectations.
* Primary contact for carrier onboarding/operational readiness

**Vendor Compliance & Collaboration**

* Partner with suppliers to ensure compliance with routing instructions, shipping requirements, and appointment scheduling processes.
* Resolve vendor shipping issues impacting inventory flow or transportation costs.
* Drive improvements in supplier shipping performance and compliance metrics.

**Capacity Planning & Network Optimization**

* Analyze freight forecasts and inventory flow to secure transportation capacity during peak and seasonal periods.
* Collaborate with merchants, inventory planning, replenishment, and distribution center teams to align transportation resources with business demand.
* Identify opportunities to improve load utilization, reduce empty miles, and increase transportation efficiency.

**Operational Execution**

* Manage daily transportation execution activities, including freight tendering, load planning, appointment scheduling, and shipment tracking.
* Coordinate inbound delivery appointments with distribution centers and terminals.
* Escalate and resolve service failures affecting inventory availability or distribution center operations.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain transportation performance dashboards and scorecards.
* Analyze transportation spend, service metrics, freight trends, and network performance.
* Communicate operational performance, risks, and opportunities to leadership.
* Utilize TMS, and reporting tools to support decision-making.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify cost-saving and productivity improvement opportunities across the inbound transportation network.
* Lead and support transportation initiatives related to process standardization, automation, and network optimization.
* Develop and maintain SOPs and best practices for inbound transportation operations.
* Participate in cross-functional projects supporting supply chain and logistics transformation initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner with Distribution Center Operations, Inventory Planning, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, and Procurement teams.
* Coordinate transportation support for new store openings, DC transitions, seasonal sets, and network changes.
* Ensure alignment between transportation execution and broader supply chain objectives.

**Typical KPIs**

* On-Time Pickup %
* On-Time Delivery %
* Carrier Tender Acceptance %
* Transportation Cost per Unit/Case
* Load Fill/Density Utilization
* Vendor Compliance %
* Transit Time Performance
* Claims and Damage Rates
* Inbound Appointment Compliance
* Freight Cost Savings and Avoidance

**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Serve as a subject matter expert for inbound transportation operations.
* Mentor and train logistics specialists and coordinators.
* Lead issue resolution efforts during transportation disruptions and peak shipping periods.
* Present transportation performance, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.

*Does working as part of a close-knit, friendly team inspire you? Do you find enjoyment in helping customers with their needs over the phone?*  
  
**Come Join ReSource Pro!**

  
**Your role:**  
We are seeking a **Customer Experience Associate** who provides front-line customer service support on behalf of ReSource Pro clients via phone, email, and/or chat. This customer-facing role is responsible for handling customer inquiries professionally, politely, and efficiently while documenting work in client systems. The work completed directly impacts trust and partnership with the client.  
  
We hire the best because our service is only as good as the people delivering it. We’re committed to hiring individuals who engage in our amazing culture and embrace our Core Values: Commitment to Community, Teamwork, Passion for Excellence, Service-Centric, and Best Self.  
  
**In This Role, You Will...**

* Manage inbound/outbound calls and emails as a subject matter expert
* Providing clear communication to brokers and insurers (via phone, email, and chat).
* Providing exceptional customer service to client customers
* Completing requested client/broker tasks and processes
* Collaborating with peers and leaders to meet client needs
* Contributing to the achievement of internal team goals

  
**What You Need To Be Successful...**

* 1-2 years customer service experience required
* Insurance background/knowledge preferred
* Reliable and professional
* Ability to follow processes and procedures
* Strong organizational and time-management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Proficient computer skills
* Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks
* Detail-oriented and accurate
* Positive and proactive attitude
* Flexibility and adaptability to changing priorities

  
**Your Compensation...**  
Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes annual bonus eligibility, benefits, and other opportunities at ReSource Pro. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, geography, and balancing internal equity relative to other ReSource Pro employees. This is a hybrid position out of our office in Vincennes, IN and the salary range for this location and role is **$15.00 - $24.85 per hour**. The salary range could be lower or higher based on the specific geographic location in which the candidate resides.

**Your Benefits & Perks...**

* 100% paid employee health insurance available on Day 1
* Eligible for all medical, dental, and vision benefits on Day 1
* Remote positions are Internet stipend-eligible
* 401k with employer match, vested on Day 1
* HSA/FSA available
* Long Term and short-term disability employer-provided
* Generous PTO plan with paid holidays + floating holidays
* Development and growth opportunities
* Comprehensive wellness program and prioritization of employee health

**Your Interview Process...**  
To be considered for this position, please submit your application. If you meet the qualifications for the role, a member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch to schedule an interview via Zoom.  
  
The standard interview process includes:

* Behavioral Interview with Talent Acquisition
* Online talent assessment
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Additional interview steps may be added depending on the position or if further evaluation is needed.

  
Disclosure: Candidates are evaluated at each step of the process. As a result, not every candidate will complete all steps in the process.

**About ReSource Pro:**

Focused exclusively on the insurance industry, ReSource Pro is the trusted partner insurance organizations rely on to optimize performance, streamline operations and process engineering, and drive growth. Serving 2,000+ carriers, brokers, wholesalers, and MGAs, ReSource Pro is a recognized market leader in insurance workflow optimization, data and technology services, and strategic operating model transformation. Maintaining a 96%+ client retention rate for over a decade, ReSource Pro is the only firm serving the insurance industry to have earned a spot on the Inc. 5000 list 16 times—placing it among the top 0.02% of repeat honorees across all sectors in the Inc. list’s 40+ year history.

ReSource Pro provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

ad32c2db25e98793deab.title: Contract Recruiter
ad32c2db25e98793deab.description:
Vestwell is the financial technology company powering the new savings economy. The New York City-based fintech platform redefines how people save for the critical aspects of life across retirement, education, and healthcare savings needs. Today, Vestwell enables over 790,000 businesses and more than 2.75 million active savers, with over $57 billion in assets saved across all 50 United States.

Vestwell offers a range of products, including workplace-delivered retirement plans, employer-offered student loan repayment benefits, and various savings accounts for education, emergencies, and individuals with disabilities.

Vestwell's platform serves a diverse clientele, including financial advisers, employers, third-party administrators, financial institutions, payroll providers, government agencies, and individual savers. To learn more, visit vestwell.com

**Who Are We Looking For?**  
  
We are seeking a mid-level Recruiter to help Vestwell expand by hiring top-notch Operations, Services, and G&A roles in our New York or King of Prussia office. In this role, you'll partner with leadership teams to determine recruitment needs and develop hiring strategies. You'll own search strategy and sourcing approach, advise hiring managers on market conditions, compensation, and selection decisions, and negotiate and extend offers to candidates. You will also ensure data integrity in Rippling (our HRIS) and Greenhouse (our ATS) and advise and influence hiring teams in making objective hiring decisions. To ensure success, the Recruiter should have a demonstrable track record in hiring talented candidates across business functions. Outstanding recruiters study metrics to track recruitment successes and identify opportunities for improvement in the hiring process.  
  
**What Will You Be Doing?**  
  
Day-to-day you will be expected to:

* Own full-cycle recruiting for entry to Senior Manager level Operations, Services, and G&A roles.
* Develop and implement hiring strategies in consultation with hiring managers, advising them on market conditions, compensation, and selection decisions.
* Determine the audience, method, and reach of the hiring process for each search.
* Negotiate and extend offers to candidates.
* Develop recruitment marketing strategy and campaigns that position Vestwell as an employer of choice.
* Select and advertise positions via suitable recruitment platforms and networks.
* Ensure data integrity in Greenhouse and Rippling and use recruiting metrics to improve the hiring process.

**Requirements**

*The Necessities:*

* 2-3 years of full-cycle recruitment experience
* Experience working with internal and external clients with competing priorities and deadlines
* Excellent interpersonal communication and time management skills
* Strong social aptitude and ability to build relationships across functions and levels
* Industry knowledge to be able to talk to job prospects and understand qualifications
* Ability to quickly adapt to and learn new tools as needed; proactive in learning independently and applying to on-the-job scenarios
* Hunger and drive to grow into a talent acquisition expert for Vestwell
* Proficient in recruiting ATS platforms; preferably Greenhouse

*The Extras:*

* Internal and external negotiation skills
* Previous work experience in sales, research, operations, customer service, information technology, administration, schedule coordination, or other related jobs
* Experience with project and program management
* Experience working in startup and or FinTech environment(s)

This role will be based in our New York or King of Prussia office, and will be part of Vestwell's hybrid in-office operation.

This role will be hired on a W-2, contract-to-hire basis of up to 3 months, with the potential to extend and/or convert to full-time employment.

The expected base salary range for this position is $70K - $85K base. This position is eligible to participate in the Company Bonus Pool and is eligible to receive new hire equity in the Company. Please note that salary bands are based on NY and other similar metro areas and may differ based on where the role is ultimately hired.

**Employee Benefits**  
We're an innovative, high-growth company with an exciting future ahead. At Vestwell, we prioritize employee wellbeing through comprehensive health benefits, generous time off, and a dedicated Employee Wellbeing Committee. Our hybrid work model offers flexibility while providing access to our collaborative offices in Midtown Manhattan, Austin, King of Prussia, and Scottsdale. And, of course, as a company focused on helping people save for the future, we offer a competitive 401(k) plan.

**Interview Process**  
Our interview process starts the same for every candidate with 1-2 introductory conversations to learn more about your background, interests, and what you're looking for, while also giving you the opportunity to learn more about Vestwell and the team. From there, the process varies by role but typically includes a skills or experience-based assessment, such as a coding interview, portfolio review, or deeper discussion of your relevant experience. Successful candidates then move on to a virtual or in-person interview panel. Before extending an offer, we complete a reference check with a current or former manager and a peer. Throughout the process, we prioritize transparency, clear communication, and minimizing surprises.

  

For your awareness you will only receive correspondence from recruiting@vestwell.com any other domain not ending in vestwell.com is not our Recruitment team.

*Vestwell's* *Privacy Policy.* *Attention California residents: In the course of conducting our business and complying with federal, state, and local government regulations governing such matters as employment, tax, insurance, etc., we must collect Personal Information from you. Should you accept employment with Vestwell you may view our California Privacy Rights Act here:* *Vestwell's California Privacy Rights Policy.*

a80103a0487569c8f230.title: Director, Grant Management
a80103a0487569c8f230.description:
**Department: Finance**

**Reports to: AVP, 988 Fiscal Strategy and Grants Management**

**Location: Remote**

**Salary Range: $115,200 - $168,300**

  

**Formerly the Mental Health Association of New York City (MHA-NYC), Vibrant Emotional Health’s groundbreaking solutions have delivered high quality services and support, when, where and how people need it for over 50 years. Through our state-of-the-art technology-enabled services, community wellness programs, and advocacy and education work, we are building a society in which emotional wellness can be a reality for everyone.**

  

**Position Overview:**

The Director, Grant Management is responsible for coordinating federal grants, with particular responsibility for SAMHSA awards supporting the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline. The Director oversees pre-award planning, organization, budget preparation, post-award administration, reporting, procurement, and closeout; ensures grants comply with funding-agency requirements, organizational policies, 2 CFR Part 200 (Uniform Guidance), 2 CFR Part 300, and other applicable federal regulations; and aligns grant operations across Finance, Program, Operations, and executive leadership. The role supervises the Grants Manager and strengthens the systems, controls, and processes that support audit readiness and continuity of 988 services.

  

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Oversee all aspects of 988 federal grant management, including responses to funder requests, reporting, and tracking of grant deliverables.
* Lead coordination of pre-award planning, organization, and budget preparation, and the post-award administration and closeout of grants.
* Manage the grants team to ensure compliance with SAMHSA requirements, 2 CFR Part 200, 2 CFR Part 300, other applicable regulations, organizational policies, award terms, and reporting requirements.
* Oversee day-to-day business operations associated with 988 fiscal and grant activities, ensuring effective coordination across Finance, Operations, Program, and Grants Management teams to support operational efficiency, compliance, and continuity of services.
* Oversee the review, approval, and processing of invoices related to 988 federal grants, contracts, and vendor payments, ensuring accuracy, completeness, timely submission, appropriate supporting documentation, and compliance with SAMHSA requirements, Uniform Guidance, and organizational financial policies.
* Provide oversight of procurement and contract activities tied to federal grant funding, ensuring proper documentation and alignment with both federal and organizational policies.
* Oversee the preparation, coordination, and timely submission of required federal reports, including performance, progress, and financial reports, to SAMHSA.
* Partner with Finance, Operations, Program, and Grants Management teams to align grant strategy, manage budgets, and ensure compliance across departments.
* Review and approve financial reconciliations and reclassification requests related to 988 grants and operational expenditures, ensuring accuracy, appropriate allocation of costs, compliance with federal grant requirements, and alignment with organizational financial policies and reporting standards
* Maintain audit readiness by strengthening systems, controls, records, and supporting documentation and addressing compliance risks and corrective actions promptly.
* Serve as the primary liaison to SAMHSA’s Grants Management Specialist and the 988 Government Project Officer, as directed by the AVP, 988 Strategy and Grants Management.
* Meet weekly with the AVP, 988 Strategy and Grants Management, to provide updates, highlight strengths and progress, and identify critical gaps or risks.
* Translate high-level Lifeline/988 policy goals, award requirements, and strategic priorities into clear, actionable initiatives for direct reports.
* Partner with direct reports on performance management, regular developmental reviews, training, coaching, and clear accountability.
* Create mentorship and apprenticeship opportunities that support teammates in developing as leaders within Lifeline/988.
* Engage in professional development activities, including leadership and DEIB training.
Other duties as assigned  

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Skilled in managing relationships with federal funders and internal teams
* High emotional intelligence and professionalism in diverse stakeholder settings

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

* Strong time management, organization, and project prioritization skills

* Strategic thinker with effective delegation and decision-making skills

* Basic understanding of accounting and use of financial data

* Solution-focused approach to challenges and team leadership

* Interest or experience in mental health, suicide prevention, or the nonprofit sector preferred
* Outstanding written and verbal communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Master’s degree in healthcare, public health, policy, or a social science field, such as an MPH, MPA, MSW, or another health-related degree, preferred.
* 7+ years of progressively responsible professional experience managing federal grants, including substantial post-award compliance responsibility.
* Demonstrated leadership experience in a relevant field, including strategic planning, outreach and engagement, staff development, and cross-functional work.
* Experience managing relationships with federal funders and overseeing budgeting, reporting, procurement, and post-award compliance for federally funded programs.
  

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
* Will constantly operate a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.
* Will frequently communicate over video calls with internal and external stakeholders to provide status updates and potential roadblocks.

  

We determine base pay through a comprehensive review of skills, experience, education, certifications, geographic location, and other relevant factors. The range listed reflects the compensation parameters for the role and does not represent the full compensation package. A complete overview of compensation and benefits will be provided by the Talent Acquisition team during the hiring process.

Full time employees will be eligible for excellent comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, supplemental income insurance, employer paid disability insurance, employer paid life insurance, pre-tax FSA for medical and dependent care, and 401K available.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they are able to perform every task in the job description. We are most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and that candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background. Vibrant will consider any equivalent combination of knowledge, skills, education and experience to meet minimum qualifications. If you are interested in applying, we encourage you to think broadly about your background and skill set for the role.

Vibrant Emotional Health is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants are considered for positions without regard to veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, creed, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, citizenship status, national origin, marital status, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, caregiver status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Please be aware that fictitious job openings, consulting engagements, solicitations, or employment offers may be circulated on the Internet in an attempt to obtain privileged information, or to induce you to pay a fee for services related to recruitment or training. Vibrant does NOT charge any application, processing, or training fee at any stage of the recruitment or hiring process. All genuine job openings will be posted on our careers page and all communications from the Vibrant recruiting team and/or hiring managers will be from an @vibrant.org email address.

1c370eaf1c9b56e17c06.description:
**Benefits:**

* Paid time off

* 401(k)
* Competitive salary

**FT Day Shift Scheduler – 7:00 AM–3:00 PM | Monday–Friday**

Hamburg, PA | Full-Time | In-Office | Benefits Eligible  
  
**Are you the person who can look at 100 moving pieces and somehow make them all fit?**  
  
Do you like solving problems, keeping people organized, working with schedules, and making sure the right person is in the right place at the right time?  
  
KRE Security is looking for a **Full-Time Day Shift Scheduler** to join our team in **Hamburg, PA**. This is an **in-office Monday–Friday position, 7:00 AM–3:00 PM**.

If you're organized, dependable, confident communicating with people, and don't mind when your day doesn't go exactly according to plan — **we want to hear from you!**  
  
**THE JOB IN A NUTSHELL**

Our Schedulers are at the center of our daily operations. You'll help manage staffing and scheduling for security personnel across multiple client locations.  
  
You'll be responsible for things like:

* Building and maintaining employee schedules
* Filling open shifts and finding coverage
* Communicating with security officers about schedules and assignments
* Communicating with clients regarding staffing needs
* Handling call-offs and last-minute staffing changes
* Tracking schedule changes and maintaining accurate documentation
* Following established scheduling procedures
* Communicating important information between shifts and team members
* Identifying staffing gaps before they become bigger problems
* Helping keep our clients covered and our operations moving

This isn't a position where you sit around waiting for the phone to ring. **Things move quickly, priorities change, and problem-solving is part of the job.**

**MAYBE YOU'RE...**

* A scheduler who already knows how to keep things moving
* A dispatcher who enjoys coordinating people and resources
* An administrative professional who loves organization
* A staffing/recruiting professional who understands the importance of communication
* Someone with operations or logistics experience
* Someone who has worked in security, public safety, hospitality, transportation, healthcare, or another fast-paced environment

0899dab7acfec6e47fa2.title: Department Chair, Exercise Science and Program Director, Athletic Training, Jefferson College of Rehabilitation Sciences, Thomas Jefferson University
0899dab7acfec6e47fa2.description:
**Number of Positions In Requisition**

1



**Job Details**

Position Summary
  
  
Thomas Jefferson University invites applications and nominations for the combined position of Chair of the Department of Exercise Science and Program Director of the Athletic Training Program in the Jefferson College of Rehabilitation Sciences.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide strategic, academic, administrative, and operational leadership for the Department of Exercise Science while also directing the Commission on Accreditation of Athletic Training Education (CAATE)–accredited professional athletic training program. The individual will report to the Dean of the Jefferson College of Rehabilitation Sciences and will work collaboratively with faculty, staff, students, College and University leaders, clinical and community partners, and professional organizations.
  
  
As Department Chair, the successful candidate will serve as the Department’s chief academic and administrative leader, with responsibility for academic quality, faculty and staff development, strategic planning, enrollment, resource management, scholarship, student success, and program growth.
  
  
As Athletic Training Program Director, the successful candidate will provide direct leadership and oversight of the professional athletic training program and ensure that it meets institutional requirements and maintains continuous compliance with CAATE standards, policies, and reporting expectations.
  
  
The position includes a full-time faculty appointment at a rank and on a faculty track commensurate with the candidate’s academic preparation, professional accomplishments, leadership experience, and scholarly record.
  
  
Department Chair Responsibilities
  
  
Academic and Strategic Leadership
  
  
Provide visionary, collaborative, and inclusive leadership for the Department of Exercise Science.
  
  
Ensure curriculum, faculty qualifications, experiential learning, facilities, and student learning outcomes remain aligned with applicable professional standards.
  
  
Develop and implement a strategic direction aligned with the missions and priorities of the Department, College, and University.
  
  
Promote academic excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement across the Department’s undergraduate, accelerated, and graduate educational pathways.
  
  
Guide the development, assessment, revision, and expansion of academic programs in response to student needs, workforce trends, professional developments, and emerging areas of exercise and health science.
  
  
Strengthen pathways connecting exercise science with athletic training and other rehabilitation and health professions.
  
  
Promote interdisciplinary and interprofessional collaboration across the College and University.
  
  
Represent the Department within the University and to external academic, clinical, professional, industry, and community constituencies.
  
  
Advance the Department’s visibility, reputation, enrollment, and regional and national impact.
  
  
Maintain active professional engagement in the relevant Exercise Science professional association(s)
  
  
Faculty and Staff Leadership
  
  
Recruit, retain, mentor, develop, and evaluate highly qualified faculty and staff.
  
  
Cultivate a collegial, respectful, inclusive, and accountable departmental culture.
  
  
Support faculty advancement in teaching, scholarship, clinical practice, service, and professional leadership.
  
  
Establish clear expectations and equitable workload assignments based on faculty roles, program requirements, and College policies.
  
  
Promote faculty development, leadership development, and succession planning.
  
  
Foster shared governance, transparent communication, and meaningful faculty and staff engagement.
  
  
Address personnel and performance concerns in a timely, constructive, and equitable manner.
  
  
Make recommendations regarding appointments, reappointments, promotion, recognition, and other personnel actions in accordance with University policies.
  
  
Program Quality and Student Success
  
  
Ensure the academic quality, coherence, relevance, and effectiveness of all programs within the Department.
  
  
Promote a culture of assessment in which student learning, program outcomes, stakeholder feedback, and operational data inform continuous improvement.
  
  
Monitor enrollment, retention, progression, graduation, certification-examination performance, employment, and other indicators of program effectiveness.
  
  
Collaborate with program leaders and University offices to support student recruitment, advising, persistence, professional development, and career preparation.
  
  
Promote an educational environment that supports student learning, belonging, well-being, professionalism, and success.
  
  
Support experiential education, internships, clinical education, research experiences, and community-engaged learning.
  
  
Work closely with the Coordinator of Clinical Education to ensure the quality, sufficiency, diversity, and effectiveness of clinical education experiences.
  
  
Ensure that academic policies and procedures are implemented consistently, transparently, and fairly.
  
  
Scholarship, Research, and Innovation
  
  
Foster a departmental culture that supports scholarship, inquiry, innovation, and dissemination.
  
  
Mentor and support faculty in establishing productive and sustainable programs of scholarship.
  
  
Promote interdisciplinary research involving exercise physiology, human performance, sports science, rehabilitation, injury prevention, wellness, and related fields.
  
  
Encourage external funding, industry collaboration, community-engaged scholarship, and translational research.
  
  
Advocate for appropriate research infrastructure, equipment, facilities, mentorship, and protected time.
  
  
Promote opportunities for student involvement in research, quality improvement, and scholarly dissemination.
  
  
Strengthen the visibility and impact of the Department’s scholarly contributions.
  
  
Administration and Resource Management
  
  
Oversee the Department’s academic, operational, personnel, financial, and facility-related affairs.
  
  
Develop and manage the departmental budget in alignment with strategic priorities and available resources.
  
  
Use enrollment, financial, outcomes, and workforce data to guide planning and resource allocation.
  
  
Advocate for the faculty, staff, facilities, laboratories, technology, equipment, and administrative support required to sustain academic quality and program growth.
  
  
Collaborate with College leadership regarding enrollment management, program development, space planning, and financial sustainability.
  
  
Ensure compliance with University policies, faculty governance processes, legal requirements, and ethical expectations.
  
  
Identify opportunities for partnerships, philanthropy, continuing education, grants, and responsible revenue diversification.
  
  
Athletic Training Program Director Responsibilities
  
  
Program Leadership and Administration
  
  
Provide leadership and administrative oversight for the professional athletic training program.
  
  
Ensure that the program’s mission, goals, curriculum, policies, practices, and outcomes align with institutional expectations and CAATE standards.
  
  
Maintain sufficient authority, time, and administrative support to manage the program effectively.
  
  
Coordinate program planning, implementation, evaluation, and continuous quality improvement.
  
  
Lead regular review of program effectiveness and implement evidence-informed changes based on assessment findings.
  
  
Maintain accurate and complete program records, policies, procedures, and accreditation documentation.
  
  
Ensure that program information published for students and the public is accurate, current, and consistent with institutional and accreditation requirements.
  
  
Accreditation and Regulatory Compliance
  
  
Maintain continuous compliance with current CAATE Standards for Accreditation of Professional Athletic Training Programs.
  
  
Serve as the primary institutional contact for CAATE.
  
  
Prepare and submit required annual reports, self-studies, progress reports, substantive-change requests, and other accreditation documentation.
  
  
Lead preparations for accreditation reviews and site visits.
  
  
Monitor regulatory, accreditation, certification, and professional developments affecting athletic training education.
  
  
Communicate accreditation expectations clearly to faculty, staff, students, administrators, and clinical partners.
  
  
Maintain continuous accreditation readiness and promptly address identified areas of concern or noncompliance.
  
  
Curriculum and Instruction
  
  
Lead the design, delivery, assessment, and continuous improvement of the athletic training curriculum.
  
  
Ensure that the curriculum reflects contemporary athletic training practice, professional standards, evidence-informed care, and evolving healthcare needs.
  
  
Coordinate the sequencing and integration of didactic, laboratory, simulation, clinical, and interprofessional learning experiences.
  
  
Ensure that course content, instructional methods, and assessment strategies support achievement of program learning outcomes and professional competencies.
  
  
Verify that faculty teaching assignments are aligned with faculty qualifications and areas of expertise.
  
  
Promote effective use of simulation, educational technology, clinical reasoning, and active learning.
  
  
Collaborate with faculty to identify and address curricular gaps, unnecessary duplication, and emerging content needs.
  
  
Faculty and Clinical Education Oversight
  
  
Collaborate with the Dean to ensure that the program has sufficient qualified core and associated faculty.
  
  
Provide orientation, mentoring, support, and evaluation for program faculty.
  
  
Work closely with the Coordinator of Clinical Education to ensure the quality, sufficiency, diversity, and effectiveness of clinical education experiences.
  
  
Ensure that clinical sites and preceptors meet institutional and accreditation expectations.
  
  
Promote effective communication and collaboration among faculty, clinical preceptors, students, and clinical partners.
  
  
Monitor faculty workload and advocate for the resources needed to meet program responsibilities.
  
  
Student Recruitment, Progression, and Outcomes
  
  
Collaborate with admissions and enrollment colleagues to recruit and enroll qualified students.
  
  
Ensure that admission, progression, retention, remediation, and dismissal policies are clearly communicated and consistently applied.
  
  
Monitor student academic and clinical performance and coordinate appropriate academic support and remediation.
  
  
Promote student professional development, ethical practice, leadership, and readiness for contemporary clinical practice.
  
  
Monitor graduation, employment, retention, and Board of Certification examination outcomes.
  
  
Use student and graduate outcomes to guide program evaluation and continuous improvement.
  
  
Maintain mechanisms for receiving and responding to student feedback and concerns.
  
  
Clinical and Professional Partnerships
  
  
Develop and maintain relationships with healthcare systems, schools, colleges and universities, sports organizations, rehabilitation facilities, physician practices, community organizations, and other clinical partners.
  
  
Expand access to high-quality clinical education experiences representing varied patient populations, settings, and levels of care.
  
  
Promote faculty and student engagement in professional organizations and community initiatives.
  
  
Represent the program in state and national athletic training education and professional forums.
  
  
Support partnerships that enhance student learning, faculty scholarship, workforce development, and community impact.

**Job Description**

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess:

Doctoral degree from an accredited institution.

Eligibility for faculty appointment at the rank of associate professor or professor at Thomas Jefferson University.

Current certification and good standing as an athletic trainer through the Board of Certification.

Eligibility for athletic trainer licensure in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.

A minimum of three years of full-time teaching or comparable academic experience in athletic training education or a closely related field.

Knowledge of exercise science education and related professional standards or certifications.

A record of progressive academic leadership, such as service as a department chair, program director, associate or assistant program director, clinical education coordinator, or comparable academic administrator.

Demonstrated knowledge of CAATE accreditation standards, policies, and reporting requirements.

Experience with curriculum development, program assessment, student-learning assessment, and continuous quality improvement.

Demonstrated ability to lead faculty, staff, students, and clinical partners in a collaborative academic environment.

Experience managing personnel, budgets, resources, and competing priorities.

A record of teaching, scholarship, service, clinical practice, or professional accomplishment appropriate to the proposed faculty rank and track.

Strong written, oral, interpersonal, analytical, and organizational skills.

Evidence of sound judgment, integrity, transparency, and effective decision-making.

A demonstrated commitment to academic excellence, student success, collegiality, and inclusive educational environments.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
The strongest candidates will demonstrate several of the following:
  
  
Prior experience as a department chair and/or director of a CAATE-accredited professional athletic training program.

Significant experience preparing CAATE reports, self-studies, substantive-change requests, and accreditation review materials.

Experience overseeing both undergraduate and graduate academic programs.

Experience administering accelerated, direct-entry, or articulated academic pathways.

A sustained record of scholarship and professional recognition appropriate for appointment at the rank of associate professor or professor.

Demonstrated success recruiting, mentoring, evaluating, and retaining faculty and staff.

Experience using enrollment, financial, accreditation, and performance data to guide decision-making.

Demonstrated success in strategic planning, program development, organizational change, and implementation.

Experience strengthening Board of Certification examination performance and other student outcomes.

Evidence of successful interdisciplinary, interprofessional, clinical, community, or industry partnerships.

Experience securing external funding, developing revenue-generating initiatives, or supporting philanthropic activity.

Leadership experience in state or national professional, accreditation, certification, or educational organizations.

Familiarity with academic health systems, comprehensive universities, or multi-campus educational environments.

Experience advancing simulation, technology-enhanced learning, human-performance assessment, sports science, or clinical innovation.
  
  
Leadership Attributes
  
  
The successful candidate will be:
  
  
A strategic and systems-oriented thinker who can connect departmental priorities with broader College and University goals.

An accessible, transparent, and collaborative academic leader.

A strong advocate for students, faculty, staff, academic quality, and professional education.

An effective listener who values diverse perspectives and builds productive consensus.

A decisive administrator who addresses complex issues directly, fairly, and constructively.

A mentor who develops faculty, strengthens teams, and supports emerging leaders.

A responsible steward of financial, physical, human, and technological resources.

A leader who balances innovation and growth with quality, sustainability, and accreditation compliance.

A visible and credible representative of exercise science, athletic training education, and the Department.
  
  
Department and Institutional Context
  
  
The Department of Exercise Science is housed within the Jefferson College of Rehabilitation Sciences. Its educational offerings include the Bachelor of Science in Exercise Science, accelerated pathways connecting exercise science with professional programs in athletic training, physical therapy, and occupational therapy.

Exercise science students receive classroom, laboratory, and applied learning experiences that prepare them for employment and advanced study in areas such as health and fitness, strength and conditioning, human performance, exercise physiology, cardiac rehabilitation, wellness, and sport science.

The professional athletic training program prepares graduates for eligibility to sit for the Board of Certification examination and enter the profession of athletic training. The combined Chair and Program Director will have the opportunity to strengthen the integration of exercise science and athletic training education, expand interdisciplinary partnerships, enhance student outcomes, and shape the Department’s next phase of academic, clinical, and scholarly development.
  
  
Appointment

This is a full-time, 12-month academic and administrative appointment. Faculty rank and track will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, academic record, and alignment with Thomas Jefferson University appointment criteria.

The allocation of effort between department-chair responsibilities, athletic training program-director responsibilities, teaching, scholarship, and service will be established in consultation with the Dean and reviewed periodically to ensure sufficient time and support for both leadership roles.

Thomas Jefferson University is committed to providing equal educational and employment opportunities without discrimination and seeks candidates whose experiences and leadership will contribute to an inclusive, collaborative, and academically excellent community.
  
  
Interested candidates should submit on-line application/CV; http://hr.jefferson.edu/human-resources.html then enter in search box Job ID #

REQ-0036213

Workday Day (United States of America)

Regular

3464 School House Lane, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States of America

Jefferson is more than 65,000 people strong, dedicated to providing the highest-quality, compassionate clinical care for patients; making our communities healthier and stronger; preparing tomorrow's professional leaders for 21st-century careers; and creating new knowledge through basic/programmatic, clinical and applied research. Thomas Jefferson University , home of Sidney Kimmel Medical College, Jefferson College of Nursing, and the Kanbar College of Design, Engineering and Commerce, dates back to 1824 and today comprises 10 colleges and three schools offering 200+ undergraduate and graduate programs to more than 8,300 students. Jefferson Health , nationally ranked as one of the top 15 not-for-profit health care systems in the country and the largest provider in the Philadelphia and Lehigh Valley areas, serves patients through millions of encounters each year at 32 hospitals campuses and more than 700 outpatient and urgent care locations throughout the region. **Benefits**

* Project planning, scheduling, status reporting, and RAID management tools.

Pay: $60.00 - $65.00 per hour

**Job Title: Vice President of Government Services**

**Department: Operations**  
**Reports To: Executive Vice President**  
**Location: Remote**  
**Industry: Accounts Receivable Management (Collections)**

**Summary**

The Vice President of Government Operations leads development, growth, and execution of the organization’s government contracting operations, with primary responsibility for building scalable capabilities to support federal, state, and local government contracts and expanding the company’s public-sector portfolio. Reporting to the Executive Vice President, this executive is accountable for meeting contractual commitments, improving recovery and financial results, protecting client relationships, and building scalable operations across federal, state, municipal, and government-sponsored portfolios.

The successful candidate will combine government receivables expertise with disciplined operational leadership, financial acumen, and the ability to lead large remote or multi-site teams. The role serves as executive sponsor for key clients and as the operational authority for new opportunities, implementations, performance improvement, and cross-functional execution.

**Executive Accountabilities**

**Strategy, Performance, and Financial Leadership**

· Set and execute the operating strategy for government programs in alignment with organizational objectives, contract requirements, and client priorities.

· Own portfolio performance, operating plans, resource allocation, and the financial contribution of assigned programs.

· Establish clear objectives and accountability for operational leaders, using timely reporting and corrective action to close performance gaps.

· Lead enterprise change associated with new contracts, technology implementations, process redesign, and organizational growth.

**Government Contract Delivery**

· Provide executive oversight of government collection, recovery, servicing, customer support, payment processing, and related back-office functions.

· Deliver contractual service levels, reporting obligations, implementation milestones, and recovery goals across assigned programs.

· Monitor performance at the portfolio, client, workgroup, and channel level; identify root causes and implement measurable improvement plans.

· Ensure staffing, workflows, call strategies, controls, and technology support sustainable service quality, efficiency, and client outcomes.

**Growth and New Business Enablement**

· Serve as the operational subject matter expert for government prospects, client presentations, due diligence, procurement processes, and RFP responses.

· Assess the operating model, staffing, compliance obligations, technology requirements, implementation approach, and risks of prospective contracts.

· Partner with Sales, Finance, Compliance, Legal, and Technology to develop competitive solutions, staffing plans, pricing inputs, and implementation commitments.

· Own operational readiness after contract award, ensuring disciplined onboarding, timely launch, and early attainment of contractual and financial expectations.

· Support retention and expansion by translating excellent delivery, market intelligence, and client insight into actionable growth opportunities.

**Client Leadership**

· Serve as executive sponsor for key government clients and maintain trusted relationships with agency and contract stakeholders.

· Lead business reviews and strategic discussions with clear reporting on results, risks, commitments, and improvement actions.

· Resolve escalated service and performance issues promptly and protect client confidence through transparent communication and follow-through.

· Support contract renewals, expansions, and retention by demonstrating measurable value and reliable execution.

**Operational Excellence and Technology**

· Use performance analytics to improve recovery, productivity, quality, customer experience, and cost efficiency.

· Standardize and optimize workflows, call strategies, payment practices, reporting, and back-office processes.

· Partner with Technology and business owners to deploy automation, system enhancements, and controls that improve performance and scalability.

· Institutionalize continuous improvement through disciplined testing, documented results, and adoption across applicable programs.

**Compliance, Risk, and Governance**

· Maintain compliance with laws, regulations, agency guidance, and contractual requirements applicable to assigned programs, including FDCPA, CFPB, TCPA, FCRA, HIPAA, Treasury standards, and client-specific provisions, as applicable.

· Partner with Legal, Compliance, Information Security, and Audit to identify, escalate, and mitigate operational and contractual risk.

· Ensure timely remediation of audit findings, complaints, control deficiencies, and performance exceptions.

· Build a culture in which ethical conduct, documentation, accountability, and consumer treatment are embedded in daily operations.

**Leadership and Organizational Development**

· Lead, coach, and hold accountable a high-performing leadership team across remote and multi-site operations.

· Define decision rights, operating rhythms, performance standards, and cross-functional expectations that accelerate execution.

· Build bench strength through succession planning, leadership development, and targeted talent decisions.

· Promote an engaged, inclusive, and results-oriented culture centered on ownership, communication, and continuous improvement.

**Candidate ProfileRequired Qualifications**

· Demonstrated executive leadership experience managing federal government contracts, including direct responsibility for operational performance, contractual compliance, client relationships, reporting obligations, and service delivery.

· Proven success leading large-scale federal collection, recovery, servicing, contact center, or other regulated government operations; experience supporting state and local government contracts is strongly preferred.

· Experience leading frontline and back-office functions across remote or multi-site environments.

· Demonstrated ability to manage executive client relationships, escalations, contract governance, and cross-functional delivery.

· Strong command of performance analytics, workforce planning, process improvement, risk management, and operational controls.

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of relevant education and executive experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Experience supporting RFPs, pricing, solution design, client presentations, and post-award implementations.

· Direct responsibility for operating budgets, P&L performance, contract economics, or strategic planning.

· Experience implementing automation, workflow, analytics, or compliance technology at scale.

· Relevant industry certifications or advanced professional development credentials.

**Leadership Capabilities**

· Sets a clear operating vision and converts strategy into measurable execution.

· Uses financial, operational, and client data to make timely decisions and allocate resources.

· Communicates with credibility across agency leaders, clients, employees, and executive stakeholders.

· Leads through change, resolves ambiguity, and creates accountability across functional boundaries.

· Balances commercial results, consumer experience, compliance, and long-term client trust.

**Position Details**

· **Work arrangement:** Remote; regular travel to client, company, and industry locations is expected.

· **Team and portfolio scope:** To be defined based on assigned contracts and organizational structure.

· **Compensation and benefits:** To be provided in accordance with company policy and applicable law.

· **Equal opportunity:** The company is committed to providing equal employment opportunity and evaluating candidates based on job-related qualifications.

**Key Measures of Success**

· Contractual service-level, reporting, and deliverable attainment

· Gross and net recovery performance, liquidation rates, and dollars collected

· Operating margin, cost efficiency, staffing productivity, and forecast accuracy

· Client satisfaction, retention, renewal, and expansion outcomes

· Audit results, complaint trends, compliance exceptions, and remediation timeliness

· Implementation readiness, launch timeliness, and speed to stable performance

· Employee engagement, leadership retention, succession readiness, and internal promotions

· Documented process, technology, and automation improvements with measurable impact

The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. 02aa5a372d4f905ea8a9.title: District Support Pharmacist Part Time
02aa5a372d4f905ea8a9.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Job Purpose and Summary:**

At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our District Support Pharmacists (DSPs) play a critical role in cultivating a culture of excellence within each pharmacy worked by acting as a role model for all, demonstrating genuine care, and setting the bar for the pharmacy team.

As a DSP, you have a critical role at the forefront of delivering our purpose, modeling our values, and demonstrating genuine, authentic care for our patients. You will work within the district to cover pharmacist scheduling gaps, under the direction of the Pharmacy Manager (PM) and Rx District Leader (DL) to support our pharmacy teams. While working in stores throughout the district, you are accountable for supporting the management, oversight, and operation of the pharmacy and pharmacy team.

The DSP’s responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Living our purpose by helping to manage and improve patient health through safe and appropriate dispensing, counseling, and immunizing practices
* Traveling the district to fill pharmacist shifts as scheduled by the District Performance Coordinator (DPC); overseeing the pharmacy and serving as the Pharmacy Manager’s proxy during bench shifts without overlap
* Supporting safe and accurate prescription fulfillment by following—and directing the pharmacy team to follow—pharmacy workflow procedures and utilizing the safety guardrails at every workstation
* Assumes Pharmacy Manager’s day-to-day duties when serving as the only or the primary pharmacist-on-duty
* Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care and coaching the pharmacy team to do the same: demonstrating compassionate care, collaborating with the patient’s total healthcare team, and proactively resolving insurance and/or medication issues
* Proactively offering and delivering immunizations to keep patients healthy; engaging and supporting Pharmacy Technicians to learn to immunize
* Supporting the effective management of pharmacy inventory in all pharmacies worked by following—and guiding the pharmacy team to follow—all inventory best practices, with a special focus on protecting cold chain products for our patients and our business
* Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic
* Maintaining relevant clinical and technical skills for the job as the industry evolves (including but not limited to company-required trainings and CMEs); actively seeking opportunities to expand knowledge to better support patients
* Supporting access to care and helping to improve patient outcomes through pharmacist delivered clinical care such as testing and prescribing services (e.g., COVID/Flu, Hormonal Contraception, etc.) where permissible; empowers the pharmacy team to provide holistic care at every step in the patient care journey
* Understanding and complying with all relevant federal and state laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles; complying with CVS Health policies and procedures to help support patient safety and complying with controlled substance dispensing and recordkeeping, to protect patient privacy and security, and to maintain a safe and inclusive workplace for our colleagues

**Required Qualifications:**

* Active Pharmacist License in the state where the Store is located
* Active National Provider Identifier (NPI)
* Not on the DEA Excluded Parties list

**Essential Functions:**

* Ability to travel within a reasonable radius to support market staffing as business needs require
* Regular and predictable attendance, including nights and weekends
* Ability to complete required training within designated timeframe
* Attention and Focus:
  + Ability to concentrate on a task over a period of time
  + Ability to pivot quickly from one task to another to meet patient and business needs
  + Ability to confirm prescription information and label accuracy, ensuring patient safety
* Customer Service and Team Orientation:
  + Actively look for ways to help people, and do so in a friendly manner
  + Notice and understand patients’ reactions, and respond appropriately
* Communication Skills:
  + Use and understand verbal and written communication to interact with patients and colleagues
  + Utilize active listening by giving full attention to what others are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times
* Mathematical Reasoning:
  + Ability to use math to solve a problem, such as determining the total number of tablets to dispense, day’s supply, and/or number of full bottles and additional bottles needed to fill a prescription
* Problem Resolution:
  + Identifying challenging patient or colleague interactions and choosing the best course of action when faced multiple options
* Physical Demands:
  + Be mobile and remain upright for extended periods of time
  + Lift, scan, and bag items
  + Reach overhead; stretch or reach out with the body, arms, and/or legs to grasp items
  + Move fingers repetitively; picking, pinching, typing, or otherwise working primarily with fingers rather than whole hand or arm
  + Extend hand(s) and arm(s) multiple directions to place, move, or lift items
  + Control precision; quickly adjust machines to exact positions
  + Stoop to a considerable degree, requiring full use of the lower extremities and back muscles to move items between low and high positions, including bending spine at the waist
  + Close visual acuity to perform activities such as: transcribing, viewing a computer terminal, reading, visual inspection involving small parts
  + Occasionally lift of up to 20 lbs and/or exert up to 20 lbs. of force; Frequently lift of up to 10 lbs and/or exert up to 10 lbs. of force; Consistently lift and/or exert a negligible amount of force to move objects.
  + Express or exchange ideas by means of spoken word where detailed or important spoken instructions must be conveyed accurately
  + Have the ability to receive detailed information through oral communication
* Any additional tasks as directed by Supervisor or Manager

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 1-2 years of related work experience in a pharmacy, retail, medical, or customer service setting

Our diverse work experience empowers colleagues for career success. In addition to skill and experience, we attract and retain colleagues whose beliefs and behaviors are in alignment with our core values of collaboration, innovation, caring, integrity, and accountability.

CVS Health is an equal opportunity employer. We value and are committed to the full spectrum of diversity in the workplace, including diversity based on gender, race, ethnicity, disability and protected Veteran status. We proudly support and encourage people with military experience (active, veterans, reservists, and National Guard) as well as military spouses to apply for CVS Health job opportunities. We comply with the laws and regulations set forth in the following EEO is the Law Poster: EEO IS THE LAW and EEO IS THE LAW SUPPLEMENT. We provide reasonable accommodation(s) to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance to apply for or perform this job, please contact Colleague Relations team at colleaguerelations@cvshealth.com.

The typical pay range for this role is:

$60.00 - $76.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

d2aedf78f25ffd914ef6.title: Client Success and Onboarding Coordinator
d2aedf78f25ffd914ef6.description:
Client Success and Onboarding Coordinator

**Reports to**

Client Services Lead / Account Manager

**Direct oversight**

No formal direct people management responsibility unless assigned.

This role coordinates closely with internal specialists and delivery colleagues, including paid media and graphic design.

**Division**

CSR – Luxury Passenger Transportation (Chauffeur, Motorcoach)

Why this role exists

This role exists to lead a strong onboarding and early client experience for new accounts, then transitioning into managing ongoing client relationships, account strategy, and coordinated delivery across digital marketing activity.

The Client Success and Onboarding Manager is the primary point of contact for assigned clients, with an initial focus on ensuring new clients are onboarded smoothly, feel well supported from the outset, and have clear priorities, goals, and ways of working in place.

The role is responsible for building trusted client relationships early, creating structure and confidence during onboarding, and then carrying this through into strong day-to-day account management, strategic planning, and well-organized delivery.

The role also supports scalable delivery as the business grows by creating consistency, accountability, and clarity across onboarding, communication, reporting, planning, and internal coordination, while identifying opportunities to improve client performance, strengthen retention, and grow accounts where appropriate.

**What success looks like**

* · New clients have a smooth, well-organized onboarding experience and feel confident in the service from the outset
* · Clients feel supported, informed, and clear on priorities, timelines, goals, and next steps
* · Strong and trusted client relationships are built early and maintained consistently over time
* · Client goals, priorities, and strategic direction are clearly defined and translated into practical delivery plans
* · Account strategy is owned proactively and reviewed regularly to ensure delivery remains aligned to objectives
* · Campaigns, content, and projects are delivered in a timely, organized, and consistent way
* · Onboarding activity is well documented, with clear agreement on scope, priorities, measures of success, and ways of working
* · Routine checks and reporting are completed consistently and used to guide actions and future planning
* · Strategy reviews help keep delivery aligned to changing client priorities and opportunities
* · Briefs for paid media, design, content, and related activity are clear, actionable, and well managed
* · Issues, blockers, delivery risks, and client concerns are identified early and followed through to resolution
* · Opportunities to improve client performance, strengthen client experience, and grow accounts are identified proactively
* · Documentation, plans, meeting notes, onboarding materials, and status updates are kept accurate, organized, and up to date

**Key responsibilitiesClient onboarding and success**

* · Lead onboarding for new clients, ensuring a positive, professional, and well-structured experience from the outset
* · Act as the primary point of contact during onboarding and early-stage account setup
* · Establish clear client priorities, business goals, key stakeholders, success measures, timelines, and immediate delivery needs at the start of the relationship
* · Create a strong first impression by ensuring onboarding is organized, proactive, responsive, and easy for clients to navigate
* · Translate onboarding conversations into clear internal plans, briefs, timelines, and actions for delivery teams
* · Coordinate early-stage setup, briefing, planning, and handover activity to ensure accounts launch smoothly and with clear direction
* · Build trusted relationships early, helping clients feel confident, supported, and clear on how the partnership will work
* · Identify and help resolve onboarding issues, risks, delays, or gaps quickly to protect client experience and delivery quality

**Client relationship management**

* · Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients and maintain strong, professional, and trusted relationships
* · Lead day-to-day client communication, ensuring updates, requests, actions, recommendations, and next steps are clear and well managed
* · Build a strong understanding of each client’s business, goals, priorities, challenges, and opportunities
* · Provide a reliable and positive client experience through responsiveness, organisation, strategic guidance, and proactive communication
* · Manage communication cadence based on client needs, including more frequent communication for higher-intensity or fast-moving accounts
* · Support strong client retention through consistent service, relationship management, and proactive problem-solving

**Strategy ownership and planning**

* · Own the strategy for assigned accounts and ensure it is aligned to client goals, priorities, timelines, and commercial objectives
* · Lead strategy creation at the start of engagements using the agreed planning and design deck process
* · Translate client objectives into clear strategic priorities, channel plans, delivery actions, and measurable outcomes
* · Review and refine strategy on an ongoing basis using performance insights, delivery learnings, business context, and client feedback
* · Lead (quarterly) strategy work to assess progress, adjust focus, and identify new opportunities for impact and account growth
* · Ensure strategic decisions, priorities, and delivery plans are clearly documented and communicated internally

**Account and delivery coordination**

* · Develop and manage digital marketing plans aligned to account strategy, client objectives
* · Coordinate work across internal specialists and teams to ensure activity is delivered on time, within scope, and to the expected standard
* · Support website build projects and related delivery coordination where required
* · Monitor progress across deliverables and follow up on actions, deadlines, dependencies, and blockers to keep work moving
* · Create clear briefs and work closely with paid media and graphic design specialists to ensure campaigns align with agreed strategy and client objectives
* · Oversee social media activity across LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram for assigned accounts
* · Ensure content planning, scheduling, performance tracking, and channel activity are aligned to the wider strategy
* · Identify opportunities to strengthen results, expand scope, and increase the value of support provided to clients where appropriate
* · Support account retention and growth through strong service, strategic thinking, and proactive opportunity spotting

**Documentation and process discipline**

* · Maintain accurate documentation including meeting notes, plans, trackers, status updates, actions, and account records
* · Ensure key client information, decisions, deadlines, and deliverables are well documented and easy for others to follow
* · Use consistent processes and ways of working that support scalable delivery across multiple accounts
* · Help identify process improvements that strengthen internal coordination, delivery consistency, reporting quality, and client experience

**What this role does not own**

This role owns onboarding, client communication, and delivery coordination, but does not own:

* · specialist execution across all channels
* · design production
* · technical SEO delivery
* · hands-on paid media implementation
* · final pricing approval or contract approval
* · team-wide resource planning across the wider business
* · formal people management unless specifically assigned
* · business-wide service line ownership

What we're looking for

**Experience**

* · Experience in client success, account management, client services, onboarding, or client relationship management in a marketing, agency, or digital services environment
* · Experience owning client relationships and managing multiple accounts with competing priorities, deadlines, and deliverables
* · Experience onboarding new clients and creating clear account plans, priorities, goals, and ways of working from the outset
* · Experience developing trusted client relationships and creating a strong, positive client experience, particularly in the early stages of an engagement
* · Experience developing and owning account strategy and translating client goals into practical delivery plans
* · Experience coordinating digital marketing activity across social media, paid media, content, reporting, and wider campaign delivery
* · Experience identifying opportunities for account growth, upselling, or expanded support in a way that aligns with client needs and objectives
* · Experience working with internal specialists and cross-functional teams to deliver coordinated client outcomes
* · Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with multiple moving parts and changing priorities

**Skills**

* · Client communication and relationship management skills
* · Onboarding and client experience management skills
* · Strategic thinking, with the ability to connect client goals to practical delivery activity
* · Organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts and workstreams effectively

24a8ae3d6107b140d793.title: HR Coordinator
24a8ae3d6107b140d793.description:
**About Sagility**
------------------

Sagility combines industry-leading technology and transformation-driven BPM services with decades of healthcare domain expertise to help clients draw closer to their members. The company optimizes the entire member/patient experience through service offerings for clinical, case management, member engagement, provider solutions, payment integrity, claims cost containment, and analytics. Sagility has more than 25,000 employees across 5 countries.

The HR Coordinator serves as a highly visible, employee-focused resource during peak hiring and ramp seasons. This role provides frontline HR support to employees by answering basic HR-related questions, directing employees to the appropriate policies, resources, and teams, and helping create a positive employee experience from onboarding through operational integration.
  
  
In addition to employee support, the HR Coordinator proactively monitors workforce trends such as absenteeism, attrition, employee concerns, and engagement signals. The role partners closely with operations leaders and HR teams to conduct outreach, identify potential risks, and support retention and employee experience initiatives.

**Job title:**

HR Coordinator

**Job Description:**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the first point of contact for employee questions regarding policies, programs, benefits, attendance, leave, and HR processes.
* Guide employees to the appropriate resources, tools, policies, and support teams.
* Deliver a responsive, concierge-level service experience that builds trust and confidence in HR.
* Monitor basic workforce data and identify trends related to absenteeism, attrition, employee concerns, and engagement.
* Partner with leaders to conduct employee outreach, stay conversations, pulse checks, and retention initiatives.
* Escalate complex employee relations, compliance, or policy matters to the appropriate HR team.
* Maintain accurate records of employee inquiries, trends, and follow-up actions.
* Support onboarding, employee engagement, and workforce communication activities during ramp periods.
  

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service mindset with a genuine passion for helping people.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to build trust and establish positive relationships with employees at all levels.
* Strong problem-solving, listening, and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable analyzing basic workforce metrics and identifying potential concerns.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* At least 6 months of experience in Human Resources Administration, Employee Relations or Recruiting.
* Previous customer service, hospitality, call center operations, or a related field preferred.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.
  

**Success Profile**

The ideal candidate is empathetic, approachable, resourceful, and energized by helping employees succeed. They are naturally curious, service-oriented, and passionate about creating an exceptional employee experience while supporting leaders in improving retention, engagement, and workplace culture.

  

*The above statements are intended to indicate the general nature and level of work being performed by employees within this classification. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this job. Employees in this job may perform other duties as assigned.*

  

**Sagility is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Vet/Disability.**

  
  

**Location:**

Work@Home USAUnited States of America
