9c6247ae4f262b10e8ec.title: CRANE & HOIST SERVICE TECHNICIAN - NATIONWIDE TRAVEL
9c6247ae4f262b10e8ec.description:
**WE'RE HIRING: Entry-Level & Experienced Crane & Hoist Service Technicians Technicians**

**PAY:** **$26.00 - $50.00+/hour | Full-time**

**LOCATION:** **Travel-based | Continental U.S. service area |** This is not a work-from-home position. Classified as travel-based field service roles and will require extensive travel based on customer locations, project schedules, and business needs. Technicians may live anywhere within the continental United States and will be dispatched from their home location directly to ACECO customer sites and project locations based on business needs.

**TRAVEL:**Extensive nationwide travel required

This position is designed for technicians who want and are able to maintain a high-travel field service schedule. Assignments may occur throughout the continental United States and may include multi-day or multi-week trips away from home. Technicians should expect overnight travel to be a regular and substantial part of the position rather than an occasional requirement.

Travel schedules vary based on customer needs, outages, installations, modernizations, service requirements, and project schedules. Individual assignments may last 1–4 weeks at a time, and technicians may transition between customer locations as business needs require.

ACECO covers approved business travel expenses in accordance with company policy, including applicable airfare, lodging, rental vehicles, and other approved expenses. Qualifying overnight assignments receive applicable travel premiums and $70/day per diem.

**What This Role Really Is**

This is a nationwide traveling field service career for technicians who are comfortable spending significant time away from home.

Your home serves as your base, but your workplace is wherever our customers need technical support. One assignment may take you to a manufacturing facility for inspections and repairs; another may involve an extended outage, installation, modernization, or specialized project at an industrial or nuclear facility in another state.

This role provides considerable independence and variety, but the tradeoff is travel. If you are looking for a primarily local position with occasional overnight trips, this is not that role.

**Two Paths — One Team**

We are hiring Crane & Hoist Service Technicians at two experience levels. Whether you're an experienced crane technician ready to step into a high-autonomy field role, or a skilled industrial tradesperson looking to build a career in crane service, we have a place for you.

**New to crane service?**

**SEE SECTION 1: DEVELOPING CRANE & HOIST SERVICE TECHNICIAN**

**Already have crane & hoist experience?**

**SKIP TO SECTION 2: EXPERIENCED CRANE & HOIST SERVICE TECHNICIAN**

**Compensation & Premium Pay — Both Levels**

**Developing Technician:** $26.00 – $38.00/hour

**Experienced Technician:** $33.00 – $50.00+/hour

* Overtime after 8 hours/day or 40 hours/week
  + Saturday = 1.5x base hourly rate
  + Sunday = 2x base hourly rate
  + 10 recognized holidays = 2x base hourly rate
* +$3/hour qualifying overnight travel premium, subject to applicable OT and double-time multipliers
* +$2/hour qualifying off-shift premium, subject to applicable OT and double-time multipliers
* +$2/hour flat premium for onsite nuclear work
* $70/day per diem for qualifying overnight travel
* Paid travel time in accordance with company policy

**SECTION 1: DEVELOPING CRANE & HOIST SERVICE TECHNICIAN**

**$26.00 – $38.00 / hour | Crane Experience Not Required**

**Build Your Career in Crane & Hoist Service**

Crane experience is not required. If you have experience as an industrial electrician, maintenance technician, electro-mechanical technician, millwright, controls technician, or field service technician, we can provide the crane-specific training and field experience needed to develop you into an independent Crane & Hoist Service Technician.

Starting compensation is based on relevant industrial experience, electrical and mechanical capabilities, and demonstrated technical ability.

**What You'll Learn**

* Inspect overhead cranes and hoists — frequent and periodic inspections
* Perform preventive maintenance and repairs on crane and hoist systems
* Troubleshoot industrial electrical and mechanical systems
* Work with 480 VAC / three-phase equipment
* Read and interpret electrical schematics
* Troubleshoot motors, brakes, contactors, VFDs, and controls
* Diagnose mechanical crane and hoist problems
* Complete professional inspection and service documentation
* Communicate equipment deficiencies and repair recommendations to customers

As your skills develop, you'll progress toward independently performing inspections, troubleshooting equipment, completing repairs, and managing customer service assignments.

**Who We're Looking For — Developing Level**

We encourage applicants with backgrounds in:

* Industrial electrical or electro-mechanical maintenance
* Industrial maintenance or manufacturing maintenance
* Millwright work
* Automation and controls
* Industrial field service
* Mechanical or electrical service

Previous overhead crane and hoist experience is a plus, but not required. We're looking for candidates with strong electrical and/or mechanical aptitude, safe work habits, troubleshooting ability, a willingness to learn, and professional communication skills.

**Travel**

This position does not require relocation to an ACECO facility. Candidates may reside anywhere within the continental United States, provided they can meet the travel and dispatch requirements of the position.

This is a fully travel-based field service position—not a remote work-from-home position.

Technicians are dispatched from their home location to customer sites throughout the continental United States. Travel may involve driving or commercial air travel depending on the assignment.

Travel is a fundamental responsibility of this position. Technicians should expect:

* Regular overnight travel throughout the year
* Assignments that may last approximately 1–4 weeks at a time
* Travel to different states and customer facilities based on business needs
* Industrial, manufacturing, utility, and potentially nuclear-site assignments
* Schedule changes based on customer requirements, outages, projects, and emergency service needs
* Periods of significant travel followed by periods with different schedules depending on workload

ACECO covers approved business travel expenses in accordance with company policy. Qualifying overnight assignments receive applicable travel premiums and per diem.

**What Development Looks Like**

Progression at ACECO is based on demonstrated capability, not a set timeline. Some technicians develop quickly; others build their skills at a different pace depending on background and experience. Both are fine — what matters is continued growth, accountability, and a commitment to getting better.

**Foundation**

* Complete ACECO safety, compliance, and equipment-specific training
* Learn ACECO service standards, documentation processes, and customer expectations
* Begin performing inspections, maintenance, and basic repairs with guidance
* Build working relationships with senior technicians, supervisors, and customers
* Demonstrate safe work practices and adherence to all safety protocols

**Building Independence**

* Perform routine inspections and preventive maintenance with increasing independence
* Troubleshoot and repair mechanical and electrical crane systems with less supervision
* Develop proficiency with 480 VAC / three-phase electrical systems
* Build a reputation with customers as reliable, professional, and technically capable

**Full Independence**

* Independently manage customer service assignments
* Perform inspections, troubleshooting, and repairs without direct oversight
* Communicate findings and recommendations directly to customers with confidence
* Demonstrate the technical skills and professionalism expected of an experienced technician

**Earn Your Company Service Truck**

As you develop your skills and demonstrate the ability to independently perform required crane and hoist inspections, you may become eligible for a company service truck that you can take home, subject to management approval.

**Career Growth**

We are looking for people who want to build a long-term skilled-trade career. As you demonstrate additional crane-service capabilities and independence, you can progress into ACECO's Experienced Crane & Hoist Service Technician structure.

Experienced Crane & Hoist Service Technicians earn **$33.00 – $50.00+ per hour** based on demonstrated capability and experience.

**Bring us your electrical and mechanical foundation. We'll help you develop the crane expertise.**

**SECTION 2: EXPERIENCED CRANE & HOIST SERVICE TECHNICIAN**

**$33.00 – $50.00+ / hour | Direct Crane & Hoist Experience Required**

**Step Into a Role That Matches Your Experience**

If you have direct experience inspecting, troubleshooting, maintaining, and repairing overhead cranes and hoists, we want to talk with you.

This is field service work where you are trusted to diagnose problems, make decisions, and represent ACECO directly with customers. Strong technicians build real reputations at ACECO.

**Base Pay:** $33.00 – $50.00+ per hour, based on demonstrated crane-service experience and technical capability.

**What You'll Do**

* Inspect overhead cranes and hoists — frequent and periodic inspections
* Perform preventive maintenance and repairs
* Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical crane systems
* Diagnose 480 VAC / three-phase electrical systems
* Troubleshoot motors, brakes, contactors, VFDs, controls, and radio systems
* Read and interpret electrical drawings and schematics
* Identify equipment deficiencies and recommend repairs
* Complete accurate inspection and service documentation
* Communicate professionally with customers
* Work independently while maintaining ACECO safety and quality standards
* Support installations, modernizations, outages, and specialized projects as required

**What We're Looking For — Experienced Level**

Direct overhead crane and hoist experience is preferred. We are particularly interested in technicians with:

* Crane and hoist inspection experience
* Strong electrical and mechanical troubleshooting skills
* Experience with 480 VAC / three-phase equipment, VFDs, crane controls
* Experience with motors, brakes, contactors, radio controls
* Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics
* Experience with installations, modernizations, and outage work
* Industrial field service and customer-facing service experience

Placement within the $33–$50+/hour range is based on demonstrated crane and hoist experience, inspection capabilities, electrical and mechanical troubleshooting skills, technical independence, certifications, and overall experience.

**Travel**

This position does not require relocation to an ACECO facility. Candidates may reside anywhere within the continental United States, provided they can meet the travel and dispatch requirements of the position.

This is a fully travel-based field service position—not a remote work-from-home position.

Technicians are dispatched from their home location to customer sites throughout the continental United States. Travel may involve driving or commercial air travel depending on the assignment.

Travel is a fundamental responsibility of this position. Technicians should expect:

* Regular overnight travel throughout the year
* Assignments that may last approximately 1–4 weeks at a time
* Travel to different states and customer facilities based on business needs
* Industrial, manufacturing, utility, and potentially nuclear-site assignments
* Schedule changes based on customer requirements, outages, projects, and emergency service needs
* Periods of significant travel followed by periods with different schedules depending on workload

ACECO covers approved business travel expenses in accordance with company policy. Qualifying overnight assignments receive applicable travel premiums and per diem.

**What Success Looks Like**

Expectations are set based on where you come in. Technicians hired at the higher end of the pay range are expected to operate independently and take ownership of customer assignments quickly. The milestones below reflect general expectations — your actual ramp will be calibrated to your experience and capability at hire.

**First 90 Days**

* Learn ACECO service standards, safety expectations, and documentation processes
* Independently complete inspections, maintenance, and basic repairs
* Build trust with customers through professionalism and technical competence
* Accurately document service work and communicate findings
* Begin handling more complex troubleshooting scenarios independently

**First Year**

* Operate as a reliable, independent field resource across your assigned service area
* Take ownership of customer relationships and technical outcomes
* Handle complex troubleshooting, repairs, and service escalations
* Support installations, modernizations, outages, and specialized projects
* Demonstrate the accountability, documentation quality, and professionalism that define ACECO's senior technicians

**Take-Home Service Truck**

Technicians who demonstrate the ability to independently perform required crane and hoist inspections may be assigned a company service truck that can be taken home, subject to management approval.

**Grow Your Career at ACECO**

Our strongest technicians can take ownership of a customer's problem from inspection through troubleshooting and repair. They work safely, communicate clearly, accurately document their work, and professionally represent ACECO at customer facilities.

Senior technicians may also have opportunities to lead projects, support complex installations and outages, mentor developing technicians, and work on specialized industrial and nuclear lifting equipment.

**Employment & Field Requirements**

**Education**

* High school diploma or GED required
* Technical or trade certifications preferred

**Requirements**

* Authorization to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship
* Ability to verify identity and employment authorization (Form I-9)
* Eligibility to access export-controlled information where applicable
* Willingness to undergo a background check, pre-employment drug screen, and randomized drug testing during employment in accordance with applicable laws and company/customer requirements
* Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record
* Ability to obtain and maintain a REAL ID or valid U.S. Passport
* Ability to obtain and maintain customer-required unescorted access to commercial nuclear facilities and other secure industrial sites
* Ability to meet the posted work schedule and travel requirements and maintain reliable attendance and punctuality
* Willingness to follow company and customer safety policies, wear required PPE, and complete required safety and compliance training
* Ability to lift 50+ lbs., work at heights, climb ladders, and perform confined-space work
* Ability to work in industrial environments with exposure to weather, noise, energized systems, and moving equipment
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation

**Customer Site Access Requirements**

A significant portion of the work performed by ACECO's Crane & Hoist Service Technicians takes place at commercial nuclear generating facilities and other secure industrial customer sites.

Technicians must be able to obtain and maintain customer-required unescorted access authorization and comply with all customer security, fitness-for-duty, and access authorization requirements throughout their employment.

Depending on the customer and work assignment, additional screening may include:

* Criminal background investigations
* Credit history reviews
* Employment verification
* Motor vehicle record reviews
* Drug and alcohol testing
* Fitness-for-duty evaluations
* Customer-specific training, badging, and credentialing

Customer access determinations are made solely by the customer or applicable regulatory authority and are outside the control of American Crane & Equipment Corporation.

**Work Environment**

* Field-based work at industrial customer sites
* Exposure to cranes, hoists, energized systems, and moving equipment
* Work performed at heights, in confined spaces, and in varying weather conditions
* Strict adherence to safety protocols and PPE requirements

**Why Join ACECO?**

**Field Impact**

Your work directly affects customer safety and equipment uptime. When a crane goes down, production stops — and you're the one who gets it running again.

**Autonomy & Ownership**

This is field service work where you are trusted to diagnose problems, make decisions, and represent ACECO directly with customers.

**Technical Growth**

Work on complex industrial and nuclear lifting equipment that most technicians never get exposure to. ACECO builds custom cranes and heavy material handling equipment — the service side of the business matches that complexity.

**Stability & Compensation**

Established company with a long-term workforce, strong reputation, and a compensation structure that rewards skill and independence. Overtime, travel premiums, nuclear site pay, and per diem on top of competitive base rates.

**ACECO Values**

We look for people who align with ACECO values: Work Hard, Have Fun, and Do the Right Thing.

**Who Thrives Here — and Who Doesn't**

**You'll do well here if you:**

* Want a career built around field service and nationwide travel
* Are comfortable being away from home for multi-day and multi-week assignments
* Can adapt when customer needs, project schedules, or travel plans change
* Work effectively and safely with limited day-to-day supervision
* Are comfortable flying, driving, staying in hotels, and moving between customer locations
* Take ownership of customer assignments and represent ACECO professionally
* Enjoy variety and would rather work at different customer facilities than report to the same location every day
* Understand that field-service schedules can be less predictable than plant or shop positions

**This role is likely not a fit if you:**

* Are primarily looking for local work
* Want to return home every night or most nights
* Have significant restrictions on overnight or extended travel
* Are uncomfortable with assignments lasting multiple weeks
* Need a highly predictable daily work location
* Are looking for a traditional work-from-home or remote-office position
* Are uncomfortable working independently at customer facilities

**What's In It for You?**

At ACECO, we invest in people who want to do meaningful work, grow their skills, and build a long-term career.

* Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance available Day One
* 401(k) with company match
* Vacation/PTO following successful completion of the 90-day probationary period, with rollover in accordance with company policy
* Prior crane-industry service will be taken into consideration when determining vacation/PTO eligibility
* 10 recognized paid holidays
* Company-provided uniforms and laundering service
* Company service truck once qualified

***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

The Regional Quality Manager will be responsible for overseeing and managing the quality assurance and control processes for all PV EPC projects in their assigned region. The individual will ensure that all projects meet the highest standards of quality and comply with industry regulations and company standards.
  
  
This role is remote with required travel to visit project sites in the assigned region (Southwest) regularly to perform training and instruction to the field teams, conduct audits and First Article Inspections. The role also involves travel to meet with clients, suppliers, and regulatory agencies, and occasionally travels to various locations for seminars, conferences and meetings.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Develop and implement quality plans that align with SOLV Energy’s Quality Management System, SOLV SOPs and contract requirements for each of their projects.
* Establish, maintain, and continuously improve quality systems to ensure compliance with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations.
* Monitor project quality: Conduct regular inspections and audits of ongoing and completed projects to ensure adherence to quality standards, AHJ’s requirements, manufacturers installation instructions, code compliance; identifying areas for improvement.
* Manage quality control processes: Oversee the testing, inspection, and evaluation of materials, components, systems and processes used in PV projects within your region.
* Train and support: Provide direct training and guidance to project teams on quality assurance and control practices, SOLV Energy’s Quality SOP’s, SWI’s, MOP’s and reference guides, ensuring that all team members understand and follow established procedures.
* Collaborate with stakeholders: Work closely with project managers, engineers, suppliers, and clients to address quality-related issues and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Document and report findings: Maintain detailed records of quality inspections, audits, and corrective actions, and prepare regular reports for management and clients.
* Become proficient in the use of SOLV’s proprietary “Sunscreen” software to train project teams in documentation processes and to initiate, report and document all quality matters on the projects in the designated region.
* Conduct frequent, formal audits on documentation compliance, reporting methods, installation processes/procedures and methods, material handling, and vendor product performance.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis when needed. Utilizing both 5-Why or 8D methods, depending on circumstance, conduct and document thorough RCA to identify quality issues on projects. Create, implement and monitor formal CAPA’s based on results of the RCA.
* Continuous improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and implement corrective actions to enhance overall project quality and efficiency.
* Ensure compliance: Stay up-to-date with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices, and ensure that all projects adhere to relevant guidelines and regulations.

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:**

* Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in quality management in the solar or renewable energy industry.
* Certifications: Quality management certifications such as ASQ Certified Auditor, ISO 9001, Six Sigma, or PMP are highly desirable.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, OSHA 10, 30, Journeyman, etc. are all highly desirable.
* Skills:

  + Strong knowledge of quality assurance and control methodologies.
  + Strong knowledge of electrical construction and electrical safety.
  + Experience with construction drawings and installation procedures.
  + Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  + Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  + Proficient in quality management software and tools.
  + Ability to work as part of a team.

**WHY DO WE NEED YOU?**

The Customer Experience Associate (CEA) will drive, gather and support customer feedback and loyalty creation across all CertainTeed businesses.

The incumbent will be responsible for gathering voice of customer data and insights through multiple platforms as well as generating sales leads to the business. The position will implement and execute a strategy for data insights and fostering relationships with customers to gain a competitive advantage in the market.

The position will involve collecting customer feedback, answering product and program questions, and proactively working on promoting the business. This position is intended to be flexible in hours.

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Ensure customers receive a “best in class” customer experience by answering product questions, through inbound calls, emails, chats, NPS and outbound survey calling. These calls range from installation questions to color preferences and run across the audience spectrum of homeowners to professionals
* Proactively promote CertainTeed products and identify opportunities for business development and sales opportunities.
* Knowledge base and strong communication of all CertainTeed products and promotions.
* Participate in best practice input around knowledge sharing and enhancements to the team for better efficiency in call center.

90dc51509abd4d1707a2.title: Job Coach
90dc51509abd4d1707a2.description:
Job Coach / Employment Specialist – Part-Time

Location: Wilmington, Delaware  
Service Area: Wilmington and surrounding New Castle County communities  
Pay: $22.00 per hour  
Hours: Up to 29 hours per week, with the potential to transition to full-time  
Schedule: Predominantly daytime hours, Monday through Friday  
Work Setting: Community-based with regular local travel  
Mileage: Reimbursement for approved work-related travel

Help People Build Careers and Greater Independence

RISE Services is hiring a compassionate, dependable, and resourceful Job Coach / Employment Specialist to help individuals with disabilities prepare for, obtain, and maintain meaningful employment.

In this community-based role, you will meet participants at employer worksites and other locations throughout Wilmington and surrounding New Castle County communities. You will help participants explore career interests, search and apply for jobs, prepare for interviews, learn workplace responsibilities, communicate with employers, and develop the skills needed for long-term employment success.

A bachelor’s degree is not required. We welcome applicants with relevant experience in disability services, human services, education, behavioral health, workforce development, direct support, career coaching, case management, retail supervision, hospitality, customer service, or other positions involving teaching, mentoring, or helping others succeed.

Training is provided.

Schedule and Hours

This position offers up to 29 hours per week. Most services are expected to be provided during daytime hours, Monday through Friday.

Weekend or evening work may occasionally be needed based on participant employment schedules or coverage needs, but this is not primarily an evening or weekend position.

Weekly responsibilities may include:

* On-site job coaching at employer locations
* Job searching and completing employment applications
* Resume and interview preparation
* Employer outreach and job development
* Employment-readiness activities
* Community-based participant meetings
* Progress notes and required documentation

When a participant is not working their full number of authorized service hours, the Job Coach may provide other approved employment services, including job searching, completing applications, developing resumes, preparing for interviews, contacting employers, and teaching workplace-readiness skills.

Employees interested in additional hours may have the opportunity to transition to full-time as caseloads and service needs grow. Full-time hours are not guaranteed and depend on participant referrals, scheduling needs, employee availability, and satisfactory job performance.

What You’ll Do

Job Coaching and Workplace Support

* Provide individualized coaching at employer worksites and in community settings.
* Help participants learn job duties, workplace routines, safety procedures, and employer expectations.
* Teach workplace communication, professional behavior, time management, and problem-solving skills.
* Help participants communicate effectively with supervisors and coworkers.
* Develop natural workplace supports that promote greater independence.
* Monitor participant progress and adjust coaching strategies as participants develop new skills.
* Provide ongoing support to promote successful employment retention.

Job Search and Career Preparation

* Help participants identify their strengths, interests, abilities, support needs, and employment goals.
* Assist with resumes, applications, job searches, and interview preparation.
* Conduct mock interviews and employment-readiness activities.
* Identify employment opportunities that match each participant’s interests, abilities, experience, and goals.
* Coordinate interviews, hiring activities, and onboarding support.
* Help participants understand workplace expectations and identify reasonable accommodations when appropriate.

Employer and Community Engagement

* Build professional relationships with employers throughout Wilmington and New Castle County.
* Contact businesses to identify potential employment opportunities.
* Educate employers about inclusive hiring and available workplace supports.
* Communicate professionally with participants, families, employers, vocational rehabilitation counselors, schools, and community partners.
* Attend hiring events, team meetings, training, and other scheduled activities.

Documentation and Service Coordination

* Complete accurate progress notes and service documentation within required deadlines.
* Maintain participant records according to funding-source and organizational requirements.
* Track job searches, applications, interviews, placements, wages, scheduled hours, and employment retention.
* Communicate participant progress, concerns, scheduling changes, and service needs to the appropriate supervisor.
* Participate in service-planning and team-coordination activities.

Qualifications

* A bachelor’s degree is not required.
* Relevant experience supporting individuals with disabilities or others who experience barriers to employment is preferred.
* Experience in teaching, coaching, mentoring, customer service, hospitality, supervision, human services, behavioral health, workforce development, or a related field may also be considered.
* Strong communication, organization, problem-solving, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to work independently and make responsible decisions in community settings.
* Ability to maintain a consistent schedule and complete documentation on time.
* Basic computer skills, including email, Microsoft Office, and electronic documentation systems.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.
* Ability and willingness to travel throughout Wilmington and surrounding New Castle County communities and transport participants when required.
* Ability to satisfy applicable background-screening and employment requirements.

Preferred but Not Required

* Supported Employment, job-coaching, or job-development experience.
* Experience supporting individuals with intellectual, developmental, behavioral, or other disabilities.
* Knowledge of vocational rehabilitation or disability-employment services.
* Understanding of the Americans with Disabilities Act and reasonable workplace accommodations.
* Experience working with employers, schools, vocational rehabilitation counselors, or community organizations.
* CESP, ACRE, DSP, or another employment-support credential.

Who Will Succeed in This Position?

You may be a strong fit if you are:

* Compassionate, patient, dependable, and encouraging.
* Comfortable working at employer locations and throughout the community.
* Able to teach and motivate participants while promoting independence.
* Professional and confident when communicating with employers and community partners.
* Resourceful and willing to find solutions when challenges arise.
* Organized and able to manage appointments, follow-ups, and documentation.
* Flexible when participant or employer schedules change.
* Comfortable working independently without constant direct supervision.

Why Join RISE Services?

* Make a meaningful difference in the lives of individuals with disabilities.
* Help people build careers, confidence, and greater independence.
* Work predominantly during weekday daytime hours.
* Receive mileage reimbursement for approved work-related travel.
* Participate in paid training and professional development.
* Build experience in human services, disability services, workforce development, and career coaching.
* Access potential opportunities for additional hours and advancement.
* Join a collaborative, growing, and mission-driven organization.

Benefits

Part-time employees may be eligible for:

* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee Tenure Bonus Program
* Mileage reimbursement for approved work-related travel
* Paid training and professional development

Employees who transition to an eligible full-time position may also receive:

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Paid time off
* Paid holidays
* Short-term disability insurance
* Life insurance
* Long-term care option

Benefit eligibility requirements apply.

Important Work-Setting Information

This is a community-based position, not a remote position. Services are provided at employer worksites and other community locations throughout Wilmington and surrounding New Castle County communities.

Applicants must have reliable transportation and be comfortable driving between community locations. Transporting participants may be required as part of the position.

Equal Opportunity Employer

RISE Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We recruit, hire, train, compensate, and promote employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Apply Today

If you enjoy teaching, encouraging others, solving problems, and helping people accomplish meaningful goals, apply for the Part-Time Job Coach / Employment Specialist – Wilmington, Delaware position with RISE Services.

A bachelor’s degree and previous job-coaching experience are not required. Relevant experience, dependability, professionalism, sound judgment, and a genuine commitment to helping others succeed are strongly valued.

Temperature Testing Technologies (T3) is a growing American manufacturer and service provider of environmental test chambers and thermal testing systems. We support customers across industries including aerospace, robotics, energy storage, automotive, electronics, medical devices, and advanced manufacturing.

At T3, we focus on delivering responsive customer support, customized engineering solutions, and shorter lead times without compromising quality. Our field service team plays a critical role in helping customers keep mission-critical test equipment operating reliably.

Summary

T3 is seeking a skilled and motivated **Field Service Technician** based in or near **Chester County, PA** to support installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of environmental test chambers and related thermal systems throughout the Northeast region.

This position is ideal for someone with strong refrigeration, electrical, and mechanical troubleshooting skills who enjoys travel, problem-solving, and working directly with customers in high-tech industrial environments.

Why is Health Advocate a great place to work? For starters, Health Advocate employees enjoy helping people every single day. Employees are given the training they need to do their jobs well, and they work with supervisors and staff who are supportive and friendly. Employees have room to grow, and many of Health Advocate's supervisors are promoted from within the company. Join our award winning team!

As part of Teleperformance in the US, we were also named #95 in the 2024 ‘Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®’ in the USA by Great Places to Work (GPTW®)

**About the role**

The EAP Care Manager is a mental health professional who provides telephonic and/or live chat support to members accessing the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). This role delivers brief clinical assessment, crisis intervention, solution-focused support, referral coordination, and workplace consultation services. The Care Manager ensures high-quality member experience while adhering to clinical best practices, confidentiality standards, and organizational workflows.

This position is full-time (40 hours/week) Monday - Friday. Applicants must be able to work the schedule below.

Monday - Friday 11:30am-8pm EST

**Pay Rate:**

$28-35 per hour, commensurate with experience.

**Job Summary**

* Provide telephonic and/or live chat needs assessment and screening while managing an inbound EAP phone/chat queue.
* Deliver brief, solution-focused, in-the-moment supportive interventions and psychoeducation for concerns including stress, anxiety, grief, relationship issues, and substance use.
* Conduct risk assessments for members presenting with concerns such as: suicidal ideation; thoughts of harm to others; substance use issues; risk for abuse or violence.
* Provide crisis intervention and stabilization, including safety planning and connection to urgent or emergent resources when indicated.
* Explain EAP clinical and work/life benefits and provide individualized recommendations to meet each member’s needs and goals.
* Connect members to EAP services and/or health insurance or community resources and follow up to support successful engagement and connection to services, as clinically appropriate.
* May provide consultation and support to HR and Managers regarding employee performance concerns, crisis support, or other issues within EAP scope, while maintaining professional boundaries and confidentiality.
* May assist with Critical Incident Response following a Disruptive Event in the workplace, providing telephonic in-the-moment support to members and/or assisting with arranging onsite or virtual counseling at the worksite.
* Document all interactions and activities accurately and timely in the electronic case management system.
* Adhere to ethical standards, clinical best practices, and confidentiality requirements, including HIPAA and applicable regulations.
* Participate in individual supervision, team meetings, and case consultation.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues to ensure high-quality member care.
* Maintain reliable attendance and availability for scheduled shifts and caseload responsibilities.
* Complete required trainings and maintain competency in EAP protocols and procedures.
* Participate in the EAP on-call rotation to provide after-hours coverage (evenings, weekends, and holidays), typically assigned approximately two weeks per calendar year.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, or a related behavioral health or human services field.
* Two (2) years of clinical experience, preferably in Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), crisis intervention, behavioral health assessment, care management, or brief/solution-focused counseling settings.
* Active professional licensure in good standing (e.g., LCSW, LMSW, LPC, LMFT, LSW, or equivalent state credential.
* Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, queue-based environment while utilizing multiple digital platforms and electronic case management systems.
* Strong cultural competence and ability to work effectively with diverse populations across workplace settings.
* Excellent organizational skills and ability to complete timely, accurate clinical documentation.

**Physical Requirements:**  
This position is primarily sedentary, requiring prolonged sitting while performing administrative tasks. The role involves extensive use of a computer for typing, mouse navigation, and reading information on a screen for extended periods. Frequent phone use is required for communication with team members, clients, or external parties. Essential physical functions include fingering, grasping, pulling hand-over-hand, and repetitive motions necessary for navigating software, entering data, and interacting with electronic documents.

**Mental and Cognitive Requirements:**  
The role requires strong concentration, attention to detail, and the ability to complete tasks accurately. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are essential to address issues that may arise in day-to-day duties. Effective verbal and written communication skills are needed for responding to inquiries and collaborating with others.

**Work Environment:**  
This position is fully remote and requires a home office environment with appropriate lighting, a computer, and phone access. The workspace should be free from distractions to ensure effective focus and productivity during work hours.

Company Overview

Health Advocate is the nation’s leading provider of health advocacy, navigation, well-being and integrated benefits programs. For 20 years, Health Advocate has provided expert support to help our members navigate the complexities of healthcare and achieve the best possible health and well-being. Our solutions leverage a unique combination of best-in-class, personalized support with powerful predictive data analytics and a proprietary technology platform to address nearly every clinical, administrative, wellness or behavioral health need. Whether facing common issues or an unprecedented challenge like COVID-19, our team of highly trained, compassionate experts work together to go above and beyond expectations, making healthcare easier for our members and ensuring they get the care they need.

Learn more

Health Advocate https://www.healthadvocate.com/site/

**Senior On-Site Service Specialist**

POSITION PROFILE

Provides operations functions in one or all of the following areas: operates high volume duplicating, production, sorting, mailing, or bindery equipment, performs associated copying tasks, ships and receives product and supplies, sorts, distributes and handles incoming and outgoing mail/faxes, as well as applies necessary postage. Provides copier maintenance and/or repair of customer site equipment.

May also perform bindery, QC and final check, housekeeping/Hospitality, file services, call center representative, and reception, etc. May performs various building support functions related to meeting set ups and light maintenance. Note: Due to the higher level of presentation and telephone skills needed to perform as well as temporary/occasional receptionist duties, employees performing this function are considered to be Senior On-Site Services Specialist. This position reports directly to the Site Manager, Site Supervisor or Assistant Site Manager, depending on site personnel configuration.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

· Runs high volume/production copy machines and performs binding and finishing work.

· Ensures convenience copiers are working properly, checking for quality via daily inspections. Clears paper jams and informs technicians of specific problems.

· Perform basic equipment troubleshooting and escalate calls to technicians

· Performs setup of equipment as prescribed by the customer(toner add, stocks paper, etc)

· Performs duties of scanning and /or imaging documents

· May perform Reception services on temporary/occasional basis

· Maintains records for management reports and inventories of supplies needed.

· Distributes office supplies, fax transmissions and mail to company personnel and/or designated drop-off points as required.

· Calculates charges for jobs performed and maintains logs and may generate reports.

· Responds to and coordinates all service calls required by customer.

· May perform filing duties in conjunction with specific customer requests.

· Delivers completed jobs to pre-determined customer locations within and outside of the site.

· Maintains daily meter and service logs.

· May travel between customer's buildings.

· Answers customer questions regarding status or feasibility of job requests.

· Ensures upkeep of convenience copier areas by keeping neat and well stocked.

· Performs duties related to the shipping of materials.

· Performs duties related to the receiving of materials.

· May perform meeting room and conference room set ups.

· May perform building occupant moves within assigned facilities.

· May perform light maintenance, and cleaning duties as assigned.

· May occasionally perform shipping, receiving and dock work in a mailroom type environment

· May require periodic overtime on nights and weekends, including off-hour emergency response.

· Uses shrink-wrap machine, paper cutter, hole driller, bindery equipment, jogger, tape machine, stackers, electric stapler and scales in completion of various jobs contracted.

· Uses all copier equipment, calculator, fax machine, postage meter and some PC.

· Performs filing duties, which may include �purging' and archiving old documents.

· Understanding of Ricoh Services Portfolio & Technology

· Ensures data for Ricoh MOR, SPG and job logs are captured

· Performs other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications (Education, Experience and Certifications)**

· Requires high school diploma or GED and1-2 years of related work experience.

· Some related copy job experience is preferred.

· May require valid driver's license and minimum levels of auto insurance coverage per Ricoh.

· Demonstrate competency in basic computer skills including proficiency in MS Office Suite

KNOWLEDGE, Skills And Abilities

· Working knowledge of copier and other related equipment and repair is preferred.

· Requires knowledge and understanding of shipping/receiving procedures.

· Basis electronics knowledge is preferred.

· Possesses ability to work independently and flexibly to complete projects.

· Possesses ability to determine correct method and packing material as well as check packing slips for accuracy of incoming materials.

· Possesses ability to comprehend instructions concerning mail delivery.

· Possesses troubleshooting and problem solving skills.

· Possesses ability to read and comprehend written technical information in the form of manuals, parts books and related publications.

· Possesses excellent customer relations skills and excellent verbal communication skills.

**Working Conditions, MENTAL aND PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

· Requires frequent exposure to copier/fax machine noise, toner and changes in room temperature and may be exposed to frequent paper cuts from the handling of paper and opening of boxes.

· Requires exposure to various weather conditions when walking is necessary between buildings and exposure to location equipment can present opportunities for injury or accidents.

· Makes daily telephone/in-person contact with customers, employees, managers and/or Dispatch Department and occasional telephone contact with vendors and equipment repair people.

· Dealing with tight deadlines and quick turnaround times imposes high stress levels.

· Some physical effort is required which may involve long periods of standing, walking, bending, reaching, stretching, climbing or similar activities as well as lifting or moving items weighing up to 50 lbs. and in pushing or pulling machines on wheels, which may weigh up to 400 lbs., in order to move for repairs. Walking between buildings may be necessary.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with a job.

a0fa40eaa7e1fa99d454.description:
**Job Type:** Part time
  
  
**Caregiver | Direct Support Professional DSP | Home Health:**  
**Location:** Pennsylvania
  
**Work Location:** Field-Based
  
**Schedule:** Flexible
  
**FLSA Status:** Non-Exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and applicable Pennsylvania law
  
  
**About Our Company:**  
OneWell Health Care and its affiliate, OneWell of Pennsylvania LLC, are dedicated to empowering individuals with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (IDD) and Autism to lead fulfilling, self-directed lives. We provide compassionate, person-centered care that promotes dignity, independence, and inclusion across community and home settings.
  
  
**Position Summary:**  
The Direct Support Professional (DSP) provides hands-on, person-centered support to individuals with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities (IDD) in home and community-based settings. This role supports daily living activities, skill development, health and safety monitoring, and community inclusion while promoting independence, dignity, and overall well-being.
  
  
**Position Scope:**  
The DSP works directly with individuals served to implement individualized service plans (ISP/IPP) and behavior support strategies under the guidance of the Program Specialist and interdisciplinary team. This position focuses on direct care delivery and does not carry supervisory, hiring, or disciplinary authority.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
The Direct Support Professional (DSP) provides consistent, respectful, and high-quality support in accordance with each individual’s care plan. This role includes assisting with personal care and daily living activities; supporting meal preparation, nutrition, mobility, and medication assistance as authorized; implementing behavior support strategies; and monitoring health, safety, and emotional well-being. The DSP promotes independence, stability, and community participation by maintaining structured routines, supporting employment or vocational activities, assisting with transportation to appointments or community outings, and providing household support related to care needs. Additional responsibilities include participating in trainings and team meetings, maintaining accurate and timely documentation, and providing flexible support during staffing shortages or special program needs in compliance with all regulatory and organizational standards.
  
  
**Regulatory Frameworks:**  
The DSP must comply with all applicable federal, state, and program-specific regulations, including Pennsylvania IDD waiver requirements, provider licensing standards, individual service authorizations, HIPAA, and all OneWell Health Care policies and procedures.
  
  
**Confidentiality:**  
The DSP has access to protected health information (PHI) and sensitive personal data. Strict confidentiality must be maintained at all times in accordance with HIPAA, state privacy laws, and company confidentiality policies. Unauthorized disclosure may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination.
  
  
**Documentation Requirements:**  
Required documentation includes daily service notes with GPS verification, behavioral observations, incident and special incident reports, attendance and shift verification, and any additional records required to demonstrate compliance with care plans and regulatory standards. All documentation must be accurate, complete, and submitted within required timeframes.
  
  
**Education:**  
High school diploma or equivalent.
  
  
**Experience:**  
**Preferred:**  

* Prior experience in caregiving, home health, or direct support for individuals with IDD
* Experience working in community-based or residential support settings

**Technical Skills:**  

* Ability to use electronic documentation and EVV systems
* Basic computer skills, including email and mobile applications
* Ability to follow written care plans and documentation guidelines

**Languages:**  
English proficiency (spoken and written) is required. Bilingual skills are a plus, depending on program and individual needs.
  
  
**Driver License:**  
Valid driver’s license may be required based on assignment. Must maintain an acceptable driving record and reliable transportation when driving is an essential job function.
  
  
**Travel Requirement:**  
This is a community-based role requiring travel to individual homes, community locations, program sites, and appointments as assigned. Flexible scheduling may be required, including evenings, weekends, and overnight shifts.
  
  
**Benefits Description:**  
**Compensation and Financial Benefits:**  

* Paid sick leave
* Vacation time
* Very competitive wages
* Referral bonuses
* Weekly direct deposit
* DailyPay (get paid before payday)
* Mileage reimbursement (if applicable)
* Retirement plan benefits 401(k)

**Health and Wellness Benefits :** (available for full time employees)
  

* Medical (PPO, Flex, and HSA plans)
* Dental
* Vision
* Critical Illness Insurance
* Accident Insurance
* Hospital Insurance
* Short-Term Disability
* Long-Term Disability and Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Pet Insurance

**Work-Life Balance and Other Benefits:**  

* Flexible scheduling
* Supportive supervisor and work environment

**Legal Disclaimer:**  
This job description reflects the general nature and scope of the role and is not exhaustive. OneWell Health Care reserves the right to revise responsibilities, qualifications, or expectations at its discretion, consistent with applicable law. Employment is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice.
  
  
If you are passionate about supporting individuals with developmental disabilities and thrive in a collaborative, mission-driven environment, we encourage you to apply today.:
  
  
Join OneWell Health Care — where your work truly changes lives.:
